title: llm block, schema 2: injection templates and worldbook add-on entries
description: docs/kernel-schema.md §10.2 (K-R59, K-R65). Templates per language with {placeholders}; the kernel keeps the injection budget, the degradation order, the consent switch, the entry position / depth / order settings and the rule that only our own add-on worldbook is ever written. Text of a foreign pack is neutralised before it reaches the host ({{…}} macros other than {{user}} / {{char}}, <% and %> are escaped) and capped at 16 entries, 2000 code points each, 16 000 in total. Absent block = kernel templates in the pack language and no rule entries.

book.description: Name of our add-on book, before the fixed kernel suffix the kernel always appends (so it is never the card's own book). Default: the pack title (K-R05).

tag.description: Bracket tag of the event background line.

id.description: Stable id written into the entry's ownership marker.

keys.description: Trigger words, literal; a key shaped like a regular expression (/…/flags) is refused. None = constant entry, which counts against the injection budget (K-R65).
